This fails when there are "emitAdd" (overflow) instruction groups. More details are found in the issue [link] This issue tracks re-enabling the new debug info tracking system, and fixing the new coalescing algorithm. category:implementation theme:debug-info skill-level:beginner cost:small

[Tracking] 为 Swift 调用约定实现 Mono 支持
